response_text: We lost most of our maize because the rains came very late this year and then stopped early.
My husband was in the hospital for two months so we could not tend to the farm properly.
The river flooded our lower field right before harvest and destroyed the crop.
Fertilizer prices doubled compared to last year, so we planted less than usual.
Two of our cattle died from disease during the dry season.
Nothing unusual happened this year, harvest was about the same as normal.
